semiconductor_relevance: High — SENTECH Instruments provides critical equipment for plasma processing and thin film metrology, essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: SENTECH Instruments GmbH specializes in plasma process technology and thin film metrology, offering advanced systems for etching and deposition, including ALD and ALE. Their equipment is used for precise measurement of film thickness and optical properties, supporting applications in optoelectronics, MEMS, sensors, and power devices.
capabilities: Low-damage plasma etch and deposition systems
Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) and Atomic Layer Etching (ALE)
